name: Raman spectra of multicomponent mixtures of niclosamide forms: NHa %w/w quantification (Valmala et al. 2019, Talanta 199, 679-688)
description: Raman spectra of 57 multicomponent mixtures (MCM; sheet title 'Raman-multicomponent mixtures of niclosamide hydrates') from the supplementary workbook of Valmala et al. 2019 (Talanta 199, 679-688, doi:10.1016/j.talanta.2019.03.027; Mendeley Data doi:10.17632/mv686f9r66.1, CC BY-NC 3.0; the workbook's other sheets cover NIR and MIR and are not loaded). Task: single-target regression - the Y variable is 'Concentration of NHa (%w/w)', where NHa is the metastable monohydrate-A form of the anthelmintic drug niclosamide (the other forms: NAn anhydrous, NHb monohydrate B). Levels: the calibration block has 6 spectra each at 0, 6, 18, 30, 42, 54 and 60 %, plus the authors' validation block (12% x3, 30% x3, 48% x3 'Accuracy', 48% x6 'Precision') - 9 distinct levels, 57 spectra total. The NHa level tops out at 60 %: the remaining mixture components (the multicomponent formulation studied for wet granulation) are not identified in the SI file. The sheet's remaining block is not loaded: a wet-granulation time course (Y = granulation time 0/15/60 min, 9 spectra). Raman region: 195 points, 1,051.093-1,799.338 cm^-1 (~3.857 cm^-1 spacing, identical to the binary sheet; stored descending in the workbook, flipped to ascending by the loader). The six spectra per level are the study's replicates; their preparation protocol is not documented in the SI, so is_grouped=False. Served from a frozen copy of the SI workbook 'SI- spectal Raw data.xlsx' (10,569,495 B, sha256 9d81a8d9...14ec) mirrored at HTW-KI-Werkstatt/RamanBench (niclosamide/): Mendeley Data 403-blocks non-browser clients (including CI).

rai:dataCollection: Raman measurements of multicomponent niclosamide form mixtures at nine NHa levels (0-60 %w/w); the workbook also records the authors' wet-granulation time course (not loaded here).
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The loader only flips the workbook's descending wavenumber axis to ascending; no baseline correction, normalization, smoothing or resampling is applied. Intensities are as deposited (arbitrary units). The authors' PLSR modeling was done in the paper, not on the deposited data.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Labels are the nominal NHa %w/w of each mixture as printed in column A of the workbook (the study's calibration levels); no human labelling was performed for this benchmark. The six spectra per level are the study's replicates; whether they are independent preparations or repeated measurements of one mixture is not documented in the SI.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included. All samples are pharmaceutical solid forms of niclosamide in mixtures.
rai:dataBiases: Single lab/instrument protocol; the level design is uneven (6 replicates at calibration levels, 3-6 at validation levels); the spectra are the authors' calibration and validation samples, so any model trained on them is optimised for the study's mixture design and Raman window (1,051-1,800 cm^-1, a cropped region, not the full spectrum). The composition of the multicomponent matrix beyond the NHa/NAn forms is undocumented, which limits transfer to other formulations. The CC BY-NC 3.0 license restricts commercial use.
rai:dataLimitations: Cropped Raman window (1,051-1,800 cm^-1 only); uneven replicate counts per level (3-9); the multicomponent matrix beyond NHa/NAn is not identified in the SI (NHa level capped at 60 %); the authors' own calibration/validation split is not encoded per row (all 57 rows are pooled); the replicate preparation protocol is undocumented (is_grouped=False); the wet-granulation time-course block is excluded (different Y semantics); intensities in arbitrary units (0.0023-5.71); CC BY-NC 3.0 (non-commercial).
rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports pharmaceutical solid-form analysis: quantifying the NHa (monohydrate-A) fraction of niclosamide in multicomponent (formulation-relevant) mixtures, e.g. after wet granulation; no human or medical data.
rai:dataUseCases: Single-target regression: predict the NHa (monohydrate-A) %w/w fraction of a multicomponent niclosamide mixture from its Raman spectrum in the 1,051-1,800 cm^-1 window; note the 9-level design (0-60 %) and the undocumented remaining matrix components.
prov:wasGeneratedBy: Data collection: Raman spectra of niclosamide form mixtures recorded for the study 'Quantification of niclosamide polymorphic forms - a comparative study by Raman, NIR and MIR using chemometric techniques' (Bhavana Valmala, Rahul B. Chavan, M.K. Chaitanya Mannava, Ashwini Nangia, Nalini R. Shastri 2019, Talanta 199, 679-688, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.talanta.2019.03.027); deposited on Mendeley Data (Nalini Shastri, 2019-03-09, https://doi.org/10.17632/mv686f9r66.1, CC BY-NC 3.0) as the supplementary workbook 'SI- spectal Raw data.xlsx' (10,569,495 bytes, sha256 pinned). Niclosamide (anthelmintic drug) crystallizes into three solvated forms: the anhydrous form (NAn) and two monohydrates (NHa, NHb); NAn converts to the metastable monohydrate NHa during high-energy milling in the presence of water, which motivates quantifying the NHa fraction. Each Raman sheet of the workbook: row 4 carries the 195-point wavenumber axis (1,799.338-1,051.093 cm^-1, stored DESCENDING, ~3.857 cm^-1 spacing; flipped to ascending by the raman_data loader), then one spectrum per row with the Y label in column A ('Concentration of NHa (%w/w)'). This raman_data key loads the concentration-regression rows (calibration block: six spectra per level; plus the authors' validation block); the trailing blocks whose Y column means something else are not loaded. Mendeley Data 403-blocks non-browser clients (including CI), so the key reads a frozen copy of the workbook mirrored at HTW-KI-Werkstatt/RamanBench (niclosamide/). Sheet used: 'Raman MCM' (multicomponent mixtures of niclosamide hydrates; 57 spectra: 42 calibration at 0/6/18/30/42/54/60 % NHa x6 plus 15 validation rows 12%x3, 30%x3, 48%x3 'Accuracy' and 48%x6 'Precision'). The NHa level tops out at 60 %; the remaining mixture components (the multicomponent formulation studied for wet granulation) are not identified in the SI file.
